summary: The Outreach and Access Program Manager and the Director of Granting, Toronto Arts Council, will give a presentation on Toronto Arts Council-supported arts and cultural events that cater to Toronto's French-speaking communities.
decided: The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee received the Item for information.
